entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, agent ID 401. How can I help you with your VeloFit product today?
Hi Diana. I'm calling about a VeloBand Cadence Sensor I bought. I need to return it, but I'm pretty sure I'm outside the standard window. I was hoping we could work something out.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, can you confirm the order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?

Yes, the email is sam.jones@email.com. Look, I know it's been about 19 days. We had a sudden family emergency. My husband had to have emergency surgery and was in the hospital for over a week. It was a complete whirlwind.
Oh, I am so sorry to hear that. I hope he's recovering well. Just so I can properly document this, what specifically is the issue with the VeloBand? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

No fault at all, it works great. It's just a preference. To be honest, with everything going on, especially with his upcoming deployment, I just want something simpler. I understand if a full refund isn't possible, but maybe a partial credit or a discount code for a future purchase?
I appreciate you explaining the situation, and thank you for being so understanding. Let me just pull up the policy for your item... One moment.
Okay, I have your order details here. It looks like you received the VeloBand 19 days ago. Sam, you're actually well within the return window. There's no need for any special exception.
Really? I was sure I read somewhere that it was a 10 or 15-day policy. I was all prepared to negotiate.

Not for this item. The VeloBand Cadence Sensor falls under our standard 90-day return policy. So, I can go ahead and process a return for a full refund to your original payment method, no problem at all.
Wow, that's fantastic! What a relief. Thank you so much, Diana. I really appreciate you checking that for me.

It's my pleasure. I'm glad I could make things a little easier for you. I've just sent a prepaid return label to your email. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed within 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. Thanks again for your help and for being so kind.
You are very welcome, Sam. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Have a great day!
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
